name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
detailed_description:
Wishlist & Play the demo first! ✨


About the Game

🕹️ Welcome to Replay Value – the ultimate second-hand game store sim!
Start from scratch and build your dream retro game shop in this quirky and satisfying job simulator. Buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, and turn forgotten discs into hot-shelf hits.

Whether you're restoring a dusty classic or haggling over a rare gem, your goal is simple: make profit, grow your inventory, and create a store worthy of the name Replay Value.

🛒 Features


🎮 Buy, Sell, Haggle
Deal with random customer requests every day—some want to sell their collection, others are after something specific. Negotiate prices, make counter-offers, and decide when to walk away.

🧼 Restore & Reuse
Fix up old games through interactive mini-games like CD cleaning, box repair, tag removal, and disk checks. Presentation matters—clean games sell better!

📦 Manage Your Store
Physically place games on your shop shelves, tag them with prices, and decide what to display. Want to sell something online instead? Use the digital storefront and check for end-of-day sales.

📈 Upgrade & Expand
Invest your earnings to unlock new platforms like consoles and handhelds, buy extra shelves, and decorate your store with posters, stickers, and figures. Even run ads to bring in more customers!

📊 Daily Summary
Track your profits, sold inventory, and missed opportunities with a handy end-of-day report, inspired by classic sim games.

📅 Infinite Replayability
With randomized customers, negotiation quirks, and hundreds of games to collect, every day is a fresh challenge. Can you master the market and make your shop the ultimate second-hand paradise?

Whether you're a collector at heart or just here for the hustle, Replay Value is a cozy, strategic sim full of nostalgia, charm, and unexpected deals.

📦 Time to clean up that cartridge, name your price, and make your shelf shine.

short_description: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or layer
  • Processor: Intel Pentium CPU G860
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 840M
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 64 Bit Only
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended
